marta: Release-train heads-up: scheduled cutover to retire model-serving-v1 next week during the freeze window (2026-04-20 02:00-08:00 UTC). Please read the migration notes and flag blockers.

marta: TL;DR:
- Deprecation: model-serving-v1 -> final traffic cutoff during freeze window.
- Migration path: traffic shifted via 'fast-roll' lane: 1% (15m) -> 10% (30m) -> 50% (45m) -> 100% if all gates pass.
- Fast-roll lane behavior: automated health gate checks + auto-revert on two consecutive gate failures.
- Dedicated tenants: you will remain on v1 unless you opt into migration; opt-out deadline: 2026-04-17 12:00 UTC.

leo: What are the gates for fast-roll?
marta: Health gates:
- global 5xx rate delta <= 0.1% over 5m
- p99 latency delta <= +12%
- model-quality regression on eval set <= 2% absolute accuracy drop
If a gate trips the fast-roll system will automatically step percent->0 and publish the revert event.

oncall: Who is on immediate rollback duty if automation fails?
marta: If automation fails, @leo will run manual rollback commands; @release-czar covers if leo is unavailable. Manual rollback commands: `rctl fast-roll set --service=model-serving --percent=0` and `kubectl rollout undo deployment/model-serving -n inference`.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: fast-roll job preflight scheduled: 2026-04-20T01:30:00Z  job id: fr-20260420-0130

release-czar: I will add an exec note and the deprecation timeline to the weekly changelog. Exec asks for a one-paragraph impact summary; draft: "We are retiring model-serving-v1 to consolidate feature parity and reduce maintenance overhead. Migration uses a guarded fast-roll with automated safety gates; Dedicated tenants can opt out until 2026-04-17." Thoughts?

leo: Add a line about the eval gate (where results will live) and who owns triage for quality regressions: `ml-evals/model-serving/migration-20260420` and assign @oncall as observer.

marta: Good call. I've added the eval path and assigned ownership. I will post live markers in this thread during the cutover (preflight, step-ups, any auto-reverts, completion). Please DM if you spot a blocker before the freeze.
